title: Color / Neutrals
slide_intent: Separate quiet utility from expressive color because hierarchy needs supporting tones that do not compete for attention.
strategic_value: A neutral scale can help Duolingo organize information while leaving recognition and emphasis to its brighter colors.
demonstration: Six neutral swatches run from Eel through Wolf, Hare, Swan and Polar to Snow, each with values, beside a role statement.
practical_value: Choose a supporting neutral when the task is utility or hierarchy rather than expressive emphasis.
